title: Buena Vida Tea Bar & Garden
description:
Rooted on Montana Avenue
Meet Mayra, founder of Buena Vida Tea Bar & Garden, where Buena Vida means the good life. 
She created a welcoming space rooted in community, connection, and teas from around the world. Enjoy high tea with a Latin twist or simply relax on the patio and meet new friends. Now celebrating 4 years, this spot welcomes all ages.

Buena Vida Tea Bar & Garden
📍 726 Montana in Santa Monica
